verdict.rationale: The API exposes a broad set of the capabilities users reach through the UI: text generation "as you might using ChatGPT," web/file search tools, image generation and editing, realtime voice, agents, fine-tuning (SFT/RFT), evals and batch. A CLI and SDKs are also documented. However, the evidence says API keys are created "in the dashboard," and key-lifetime and key-creation policies are enforced "in Platform settings," with nothing showing those admin functions are available programmatically. The OpenAPI spec probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. missing for 10: any documented statement of API/UI parity, evidence of programmatic API-key and org/project admin management, a published machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration that dashboard features are fully available through the API.
